samples.summary: Out-of-diff callers drive `createProgram()` + `parseAsync` directly and now get a silent rejection on any parse error (prose suppressed, no envelope)
samples.evidence: `packages/cli/test/tabs.test.ts:29-33` builds `createProgram()` and `return program.parseAsync([...])`; `packages/cli/test/schema.test.ts:29-31` and `packages/cli/test/output.test.ts:262-270` do the same. None of them go through `runCli`, so they never reach the new `CommanderError` branch. Before this change a malformed argv in these harnesses printed commander's prose via `outputError`; now `createProgram()` both suppresses that prose (root.ts:54-58) and throws (exitOverride), so such a case surfaces as a bare rejected promise with zero diagnostic output. The envelope guard lives in `createProgram`/`runCli` as a pair, but only `runCli` supplies the second half.

samples.summary: Agent-facing error-contract docs (README, developer docs) still enumerate the old error/exit contract and never mention the new stable `USAGE` code
samples.evidence: `packages/cli/README.md:116-124` is the published contract agents read: "Errors: a single JSON line on stderr — {\"error\":{\"code\":\"…\"}} … Typed errors …" plus the exit-code table, with no `USAGE`. `packages/documentation/developers/cli.md` likewise mentions only `CONFIRMATION_REQ`/`NOT_FOUND`-style codes (e.g. line 264) and no `USAGE`. Only `docs/design/cli.md:780-801` was updated. The skills files under `packages/cli/skills/` also document no error codes. Consumers of the documented contract are left describing the pre-change behaviour.
searchedFor: read packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts for an error-code registry (none)

samples.summary: `runCli` accepts any `Command`, but the exitOverride/output guard is installed only in `createProgram`, so an injected program built elsewhere still bypasses the envelope by calling `process.exit` mid-parse
samples.evidence: `packages/cli/src/cli.ts:71-76` takes `program: Command` from the caller and only relies on the guard set at `packages/cli/src/commands/root.ts:54`. Every current caller happens to build via `createProgram()` (`packages/cli/src/bin.ts:6`, `packages/cli/test/output.test.ts:414`), so this is latent rather than currently broken — a program constructed with `new Command()` and passed to `runCli` would exit the process during parsing with commander's prose and no envelope. Fix belongs on the new code: apply `exitOverride()`/`configureOutput` defensively in `runCli`, or document the precondition on the parameter.
searchedFor: grep runCli / createProgram / buildProgram across repo
